securityFixes.summary: Fixed vulnerabilities and improved code quality

issues.issue: Unhandled JSON.parse() could crash app with corrupted localStorage data
issues.fix: Added try-catch block around localStorage operations

issues.issue: Using 'any' type for user object - no type safety

code.after: const [user, setUser] = useState<{ fullName?: string; email: string } | null>(null);

issues.issue: No additional validation for search query length
No validation of slug parameter - potential for injection attacks
issues.fix: Added regex validation to allow only safe characters

issues.issue: Unhandled localStorage operations could crash app
issues.fix: Added try-catch blocks for all localStorage operations

issues.issue: Product name not sanitized in WhatsApp link - XSS risk
issues.fix: Added sanitization to remove potentially dangerous characters
Updated to modern API with behavior option

issues.issue: No validation for negative prices - could result in negative total
issues.fix: Added validation and protection against negative prices

code.after:
/**
 * Рассчитывает финальную цену на основе выбранной конфигурации
 * @param basePrice - базовая цена товара
 * @param configuration - конфигурация товара
 * @param selected - выбранная пользователем конфигурация
 * @returns объект с детализацией цены
 */

issues.issue: No validation for toggle option prices
issues.fix: Added check to ensure toggle prices are non-negative

recommendations: Consider adding Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
Implement rate limiting for search queries
Add input sanitization library like DOMPurify for user-generated content
Consider using Zod or Yup for runtime validation of configuration objects
Add unit tests for security-critical functions
Consider adding Sentry or similar error tracking
